name: DNA damage inducible transcript 3

function.text: DDIT3 encodes CHOP, a stress-responsive transcription factor that participates in endoplasmic-reticulum stress signaling and regulation of cellular differentiation and apoptosis.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Liposarcoma; GLI1-altered mesenchymal tumor, malignant/metastasizing. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
